title: PICKLED PORK STUFFING FOR TURKEYS
instructions: --Chop up very fine a quarter of a pound of fat and lean salted pork, break quite fine a couple of breakfast cupfuls of bread and put them in a frying pan over the fire with two heaping tablespoonfuls of butter, fry to a brown and season with salt,  pepper and any sweet herbs except sage.
